description: Our nation’s debt is more than $37 trillion. This is a serious problem. The interest alone on the debt is more than $900 billion a year. This is more money than the federal government spends on transportation, education and veterans combined.Having this much debt jeopardizes the future of important programs like Social Security and Medicare and is a hidden tax on our kids and grandkids. Instead of investing in economic growth and our nation’s future, they will be paying down the debt on the money we spent.
